recent_posts.title:
Personal Computer is now available to all users in a new Perplexity Mac app.

Personal Computer is an advanced version of Perplexity Computer.

It operates on any Mac, running tasks across your local files, native Mac apps, the web, and Perplexity’s secure servers.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity has launched Personal Computer, an advanced AI agent feature, now available to all users through a new Mac desktop app. It can operate across local files, native Mac apps, the web, and Perplexity's secure servers, enabling task automation on any Mac.

recent_posts.title:
We’ve developed our own inference engine Runtime-Optimized Serving Engine (ROSE) to serve models ranging from embeddings to trillion-parameter LLMs.

With CuTeDSL integrated into our inference engine, Perplexity can build the specialized GPU kernels faster to bring models up to peak performance on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity has built its own inference engine called ROSE (Runtime-Optimized Serving Engine) capable of serving models from embeddings to trillion-parameter LLMs. By integrating NVIDIA's CuTeDSL, Perplexity can develop specialized GPU kernels more rapidly, achieving peak performance on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures.

Finance Search is now available in the Perplexity Agent API.

In one tool call, developers can now retrieve licensed financial datasets, real-time market data, and cited web sources for agents that need current, verifiable financial answers.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity has added Finance Search to its Agent API, enabling developers to retrieve licensed financial datasets, real-time market data, and cited web sources in a single tool call for building agents that require current and verifiable financial information.

recent_posts.title:
Perplexity Computer is now available in Microsoft Teams.

Run research, analysis, and document creation directly in your Teams workspace with the same capabilities as Computer.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity Computer is now integrated into Microsoft Teams, enabling users to run research, analysis, and document creation directly within the Teams workspace using the same capabilities as the standalone Computer product.

recent_posts.title:
GPT-5.5 is now available on Perplexity for Max subscribers.

GPT-5.5 is also rolling out as the default orchestration model in Computer for both Pro and Max subscribers.
recent_posts.summary: GPT-5.5 is now available on Perplexity for Max subscribers, and is also rolling out as the default orchestration model in Computer for both Pro and Max subscribers.

recent_posts.title: Kimi K2.6, the new state-of-the-art open-weight model from Moonshot, is now available for Pro and Max subscribers.
recent_posts.summary: Kimi K2.6, a new open-weight AI model from Moonshot, has been released and is now accessible to Pro and Max subscribers. It is positioned as a state-of-the-art open-weight model.

recent_posts.title:
We've published new research on how we post-train models for accurate search-augmented answers.

Our SFT + RL pipeline improves search, citation quality, instruction following, and efficiency.

With Qwen models, we match or beat GPT models on factuality at a lower cost.
recent_posts.summary: New research details a post-training pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve search-augmented language model answers. The approach enhances factuality, citation quality, instruction following, and efficiency. Using open-weight models like those from the open-source model family, the pipeline matches or outperforms GPT models on factuality benchmarks at lower cost.

recent_posts.title:
Claude Opus 4.7 is now the default orchestration model powering Computer.

It's also available for Max subscribers on Perplexity web, iOS, and Android.
recent_posts.summary: Claude Opus 4.7 has been set as the default orchestration model for Computer, and is now accessible to Max subscribers on Perplexity across web, iOS, and Android platforms.

recent_posts.title:
Today we're releasing Personal Computer.

Personal Computer integrates with the Perplexity Mac App for secure orchestration across your local files, native apps, and browser.

We’re rolling this out to all Perplexity Max subscribers and everyone on the waitlist starting today.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity is launching Personal Computer, a new feature integrated with the Perplexity Mac App that enables secure orchestration across local files, native apps, and browsers. The rollout begins today for Perplexity Max subscribers and waitlist members.

recent_posts.title:
Today we're announcing the Billion Dollar Build.

An 8-week competition where teams will use Perplexity Computer to build a company with a path to $1B.

Finalists have the opportunity to secure up to $1M in investment from the Perplexity Fund and up to $1M in Computer credits.
recent_posts.summary: Perplexity is launching the 'Billion Dollar Build', an 8-week competition where teams use Perplexity Computer to build a company with a path to $1B valuation. Finalists can win up to $1M in investment from the Perplexity Fund and up to $1M in Computer credits.
